changeSet.author: ${claude}
changeSet.sql: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS "uuid-ossp" WITH SCHEMA public;

changeSet.author: ${claude}
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE administration.users ( id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, external_id uuid NOT NULL, version smallint NOT NULL, created_on timestamp NOT NULL, last_update timestamp, name varchar(150) NOT NULL, email varchar(150) NOT NULL, password varchar(255) NOT NULL, active boolean NOT NULL, default_language varchar(5) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT users_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT users_external_id_key UNIQUE (external_id), CONSTRAINT users_id_external_id_key UNIQUE (id, external_id), CONSTRAINT users_email_key UNIQUE (email) );

changeSet.author: ${claude}
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE administration.roles ( id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, external_id uuid NOT NULL, version smallint NOT NULL, created_on timestamp NOT NULL, last_update timestamp, name varchar(45) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT roles_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT roles_external_id_key UNIQUE (external_id), CONSTRAINT roles_id_external_id_key UNIQUE (id, external_id) );

changeSet.author: ${claude}
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE administration.grants ( id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, external_id uuid NOT NULL, version smallint NOT NULL, created_on timestamp NOT NULL, last_update timestamp, id_user bigint NOT NULL, id_role bigint NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT grants_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT grants_external_id_key UNIQUE (external_id), CONSTRAINT grants_id_external_id_key UNIQUE (id, external_id), CONSTRAINT fk_users_on_grants FOREIGN KEY (id_user) REFERENCES administration.users (id), CONSTRAINT fk_roles_on_grants FOREIGN KEY (id_role) REFERENCES administration.roles (id) );

changeSet.author: ${claude}
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE administration.password_recover_attempts ( id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, external_id uuid NOT NULL, version smallint NOT NULL, created_on timestamp NOT NULL, last_update timestamp, token uuid NOT NULL, valid_until timestamp NOT NULL, used boolean NOT NULL, id_user bigint NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT password_recover_attempts_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT password_recover_attempts_external_id_key UNIQUE (external_id), CONSTRAINT password_recover_attempts_id_external_id_key UNIQUE (id, external_id), CONSTRAINT fk_users_on_password_recover_attempts FOREIGN KEY (id_user) REFERENCES administration.users (id) ); ALTER TABLE administration.password_recover_attempts ADD CONSTRAINT password_recover_attempts_id_external_id_key1 UNIQUE (id, external_id);

changeSet.author: ${claude}
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE administration.account_activation_attempt ( id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, external_id uuid NOT NULL, version smallint NOT NULL, created_on timestamp NOT NULL, last_update timestamp, token uuid NOT NULL, valid_until timestamp NOT NULL, activated_on timestamp, id_user bigint NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT account_activation_attempt_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT account_activation_attempt_external_id_key UNIQUE (external_id), CONSTRAINT account_activation_attempt_id_external_id_key UNIQUE (id, external_id), CONSTRAINT fk_users_on_account_activation_attempt FOREIGN KEY (id_user) REFERENCES administration.users (id) ); ALTER TABLE administration.account_activation_attempt ADD CONSTRAINT account_activation_attempt_id_external_id_key1 UNIQUE (id, external_id);
